workarounds.symptom: WSL: Windows Firefox cookie read fails with "disk I/O error" in copy_snapshot and is reported as not-logged-in
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(cookies): recover Windows Firefox WAL snapshots on WSL. Target files: skills/last30days/scripts/lib/cookie_extract.py, skills/last30days/scripts/lib/sqlite_snapshot.py, tests/test_cookie_extract.py. Windows SQLite keeps Firefox’s live WAL open using shared memory that WSL cannot read. When the live read fails with a SQLite shared-memory I/O error, the Windows Firefox path verifies a private copy of the database and WAL, then lets local SQLite replay committed frames. (Ref: https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1552)

workarounds.symptom: fix: attach_comments unpacks 2 values from a 3-tuple, so host-lane comments never attach
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(reddit): unpack all three results in attach_comments. Target files: skills/last30days/scripts/lib/reddit_hydrate.py, tests/test_reddit_hydrate.py, changelog.d/1546.fixed.md. `attach_comments` unpacked two values from `_attach_comments`, which returns three (`filled, failed, throttled`), so every host-lane / Arctic comment attach raised `ValueError` and `reddit_envelope.py` swallowed it. This unpacks all three and corrects `_attach_comments`' return annotation (`tuple[int, int]` → `tuple[int, int, int]`). The ot... (Ref: https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1548)

workarounds.symptom: Windows: Printing Press CLIs install off PATH, so Digg/arXiv/Techmeme/Yahoo Finance stay off; setup hides the "Go is required" cause; doctor's fix uses bash syntax
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(windows): resolve Printing Press CLIs from the managed bin dir. Target files: skills/last30days/scripts/last30days.py, skills/last30days/scripts/lib/backends.py, skills/last30days/scripts/lib/health.py. On Windows, Digg, arXiv, Techmeme and Yahoo Finance now turn on after setup without a manual PATH edit. The Printing Press installer puts those CLIs in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\PrintingPress\bin`, which isn't on PATH, so every source gated on `shutil.which` stayed off. (Ref: https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1508)

workarounds.symptom: Hermes update to v4.3.0 blocked by skills-guard-v10 (35 findings); full installer logs
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(hermes): unblock Hermes installs blocked by a dangerous scan verdict. Target files: skills/last30days/scripts/lib/backends.py, skills/last30days/scripts/lib/grok_x.py, skills/last30days/scripts/lib/health.py. Hermes users can install and update last30days again. Since 4.3.0, Hermes's skill scanner (skills-guard-v16) rated the skill `dangerous`, a hard block that `--force` cannot override; it now rates it `caution`, so `hermes skills install mvanhorn/last30days-skill/skills/last30days --force` works. (Ref: https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1504)

workarounds.symptom: Doctor misreports a failed Grok probe and hides X API guidance
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(doctor): stop reporting a broken store when grok could not be asked. Target files: skills/last30days/scripts/lib/doctor.py, tests/test_doctor.py, changelog.d/1448.fixed.md. `doctor` reads a grok probe that raised as a broken credential store and returns early, so two things were wrong at once (issue #1448): it reported a break it never observed, and it swallowed the opt-in X API lane — a configured `X_BEARER_TOKEN` produced no pin hint, while `xapi` sat in the chain findings as `ok`. (Ref: https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1481)

workarounds.symptom: Instagram: Google fallback 404 turns a clean no-reels result back into an error (v3.31.0)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: clarify Instagram Google discovery failures. Target files: skills/last30days/scripts/lib/health.py, skills/last30days/scripts/lib/instagram.py, skills/last30days/scripts/lib/pipeline.py. When an empty Instagram reels search falls back to Google discovery and that request fails, `search_instagram` currently returns empty items with no error while Source Coverage receives a generic transport failure. This makes an unavailable discovery stage difficult to distinguish from a successful search with no reels. (Ref: https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1362)
